E7: symmetry factor of D04 is 1 (distinct-species internal lines; no automorphism with labelled external legs). XVI-O's '1/2' was Unverified and never used for a value; XVI-P never evaluated D04 (excluded from ch by phi-parity) and its D11 (two identical phi lines) keeps S_f = 1/2 correctly: NO earlier value changes.
D05a_D12: genuine one-propagator tadpoles: no external momentum flows through the loop line, so the integral is scaleless; omega = 2 (D05a) / 2, 4 (D12) power divergences, no logarithmic member -> no 1/eps on either side; 0 is not a UV/IR pole cancellation.
